title: Said Out Loud at Sixty-one
subtitle: 志向与抱负 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 志向与抱负（做人与做事·理想与抱负）
meta: 主题语境：志向与抱负（做人与做事·理想与抱负）　|　核心词汇：ambition　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ambition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother had one ① ambition, which was to teach, and she was nine when she decided and sixty-one when she first said it out loud. She had ② an ambition to finish what she had started, which is a different thing, and my grandmother said the two ambitions are never the same ambition in one person.

She never ③ achieved her ambition, and she said so without bitterness in 1984, which my father said was the only thing in the house that frightened him. My uncle called it ④ ambition, meaning a hunger, and she said hunger is not the word and he said it is always the word, and they did not speak for six years; ambition, she said, is the one thing you can have without anybody noticing.

The ⑤ ambition itself, meaning the teaching and not the wanting, was nine years of a room and a board and thirty-one children, and she got eleven of it. Her ⑥ ambition for us, which she never called ambition, was that we should be able to say no, and she said this once, in 1979, and never again.

There was ⑦ a burning ambition in my brother by 1981, by which she meant the bank and the car, and she said a burning ambition is the only kind that burns the holder. My ⑧ ambition, which I told nobody, was to be the one who left, and I have never decided whether that was ambition or the other thing; every ambition, she said, has a bill at the end of it.

The  ambition I would write down, if I wrote one, is not the bank or the car or leaving, but the sixty-first year, when she said it out loud to a room of nobody. An  ambition, she told me in 1996, is the only thing you can keep for fifty-two years without anybody once asking to see it; mine has never been asked for either, and the ambition was never the teaching.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 追求的目标；夙愿
D. n. 渴望；强烈的愿望
E. 固定搭配：an ambition to do sth. 做某事的抱负／愿望
F. 固定搭配：achieve / fulfil one's ambition 实现抱负
G. 固定搭配：ambition for ... 对……的期望／野心
H. 固定搭配：a burning ambition 强烈的愿望；勃勃雄心

items.q: one ambition, which was to teach
an ambition to finish what she had started
called it ambition, meaning a hunger
The ambition itself, meaning the teaching
a burning ambition in my brother
My ambition, which I told nobody

answers.why: ambition 意为“抱负、志向”，1955 年母亲只有一个抱负：教书。
an ambition to do sth. 意为“做某事的愿望”，她还有一种把开了头的事做完的愿望，那是另一回事。
achieve one's ambition 意为“实现抱负”，她始终没有实现自己的抱负，而她说这话时毫无怨意。
ambition 意为“野心、企图”，叔叔称之为野心，意思是饥饿；她说饥饿不是那个词。
ambition 意为“追求的目标、夙愿”，那个目标本身——指教书而不是想要教书——是一间屋、一块黑板和三十一个孩子。
ambition for ... 意为“对……的期望”，她对我们的期望是我们将来能说“不”。
a burning ambition 意为“强烈的愿望、勃勃雄心”，1981 年我弟弟有了强烈的愿望——她指的是银行和汽车。
ambition 意为“渴望、强烈的愿望”，我自己那个从未告诉任何人的渴望，是成为离开的那一个。
